rule: Every governed project must be explicitly classified for asset continuity. Projects with identity-bearing visual or media assets must carry a project-local manifest and runtime/source verification before visual continuity can be claimed.

statusDefinitions.required: Identity-bearing assets exist or the project has a user-facing visual surface. A project-local manifest is required.
statusDefinitions.conditional: No canonical visual identity is currently established, but any future identity-bearing asset adoption activates the manifest requirement before visual continuity claims.
statusDefinitions.external-reference: The strongest canonical asset currently lives in an external provider or conversation-approved artifact and must be recorded with provider/reference truth until materialized.
statusDefinitions.blocked: Asset continuity cannot currently be verified because source, manifest, provenance, or runtime evidence is missing or contradictory.

Bind canonical story-commerce hero art, cover/product imagery, logo system, motifs, and campaign assets before the next visual redesign.

truthBoundary: This registry proves portfolio classification only. It does not prove a repository-local manifest exists, canonical assets are current, external assets are retrievable, runtime surfaces render them, licensing is sufficient, visual QA passed, or a visual change is merge/deploy/publish ready.
